events.title: TRANSMISSION: THE JOVIAN TRITIUM EMBARGO
events.sender: Interstellar Commerce Guild & Outer Colonies Fleet
events.body: Colony skirmish fleets have blockaded Jovian gas siphons, cutting off deep-space Tritium exports. Galactic market spot prices for Plasma-Charged Tritium have surged by +300% (from 1,200 Cr to 3,600 Cr). Commercial refineries are desperate for unrefined reserves.

choices.label: 1. Liquidate Tritium Stockpile
choices.desc: Sell 5x Tritium on the open exchange for massive immediate liquidity (+18,000 Cr).

choices.label: 2. Hoard Reserves for PMC R&D
choices.desc: Keep all Tritium secured for proprietary Hyperion fusion core synthesis.

choices.label: 3. Deploy Blockade Runner Escort
choices.desc: Deploy PMC aces to escort Colony tankers. Boosts Colony standing (+25) but risks Terran sanctions.

events.title: URGENT DISPATCH: MINING CORPS HAZARD STRIKE
events.sender: Iron Ridge PMC Pilots & Rigger Union
events.body: Following heavy pirate skirmishes across Asteroid Belt C-14, mining riggers and deployed escort pilots are refusing sorties without an immediate emergency combat stipend. Morale is deteriorating rapidly.

choices.label: 1. Approve Combat Bonus (-45,000 Cr)
choices.desc: Pay the emergency hazard bonus. Restores pilot morale (+20%) and increases extraction yield.

choices.label: 2. Enforce Mercenary Guild Protocol
choices.desc: Refuse demands. Pilots stay on standard contracts. Morale drops (-15%), risk of desertion.

events.title: CLASSIFIED INTERCEPT: SYNDICATE BLACK MARKET LEAK
events.body: Terran security forces seized a Syndicate smuggler barge carrying stripped GHA-07 Ironclad ordnance. Forensic serial stamps trace back to an unlogged sale from your manufacturing bays. Terran inspectors demand answers.

choices.label: 1. Bribe Chief Inspector (-60,000 Cr)
choices.desc: Quietly transfer funds to classify the dossier as pirate salvage. Avoids faction sanctions.

choices.label: 2. Claim Corporate Theft & Scapegoat
choices.desc: Blame rogue smugglers. Standing with Terran Coalition drops (-25), but retains funds.

events.title: PERSONNEL DOSSIER: VETERAN ACE FOR HIRE
events.body: Former Coalition frontline ace Captain Victor 'Ronin' Drake is seeking a PMC contract after refusing questionable orbital bombardment orders. Highly proficient in 120mm solid-slug cannons and hydraulic melee breaching.

choices.label: 1. Hire Captain Drake (-75,000 Cr Signing Bonus)
choices.desc: Recruit top-tier ace (92% Accuracy, 84% Reflexes). Daily salary: 340 Cr.
